method: The generator writes the complete public line-slot layout using a glyph chain trained on certain words from the public practice training split with all IVTFF units pooled. Line word-count bin and first/interior/last slot set a glyph-length distribution, then glyph transitions generate each word independently. The generator receives only word-count integers for the 5225 line slots. It rejects attested manuscript four-word runs. The book cut assigns manuscript labels and paragraph units after generation. Pooled training includes real label words among the shorter lines. A paragraph-only refit and a refit without line length are separately reported public controls.

design.primary_fit: All IVTFF units pooled. Use only public practice-training words. The sampler sees the number of word slots on each line and generic first/interior/last slot only.
design.slot_rule: A singleton is a first slot, as is the first of any multiple-word line. Later last slots and other interior slots have distinct emission tables.
design.grammar: Draw a glyph count and generate a word from glyph-transition tables conditioned on line count bin, slot role, the word's length bin, character phase and previous glyph. Hierarchical backoff serves small cells. Words have no input lexical identity, meaning, predecessor word or line category.
design.layout: Preserve the number of words in every nonempty public ZL line in order. Use only these integers to drive generation. Score in book cut so the recorded unit metadata are supplied by the scorer after the synthetic text is generated.
design.guards: Emit no glyphs marked uncertain and reject any within-line four-word sequence occurring in the manuscript. Use the all-manuscript four-word set as a rejection guard, with no positive counts estimated from it.
fixed_public_controls: Fit the same chain to public paragraph training words alone and still generate every slot using line length.
Fit all training units pooled but remove observed line length from every table key.
Report the unchanged scorer comparison on the public practice partition and the descriptive exact line-length overlap counts without retuning the primary seed.
design.one_submission: Submit the primary model's fixed generated book as one fact attack, whatever its public result.

empirical_length_exposure.split: Public project practice split only, no folio-level data in output.
empirical_length_exposure.scope: All manuscript sections, languages and scribal hands, reported separately for ZL and IT.
empirical_length_exposure.selection: Literal first word on each IVTFF line. Exclude uncertain first words without promoting another word.
empirical_length_exposure.onset: First glyph equals o under eva-basic.
empirical_length_exposure.exposure: Full parsed line word count, including uncertain noninitial tokens. Line kind is absent from bucket calibration.
empirical_length_exposure.estimand: Apply observed training-bucket rates to evaluation L and P exposure weights. In each calibration omit unsupported buckets and compare observed rates on the same covered evaluation words. Pooled rates include all kinds, including labels, so this is descriptive rather than an independent generator test.

public_evidence.scope: These controls test whether line length can carry the observed association through a simple pooled resampling process. Label-bearing and long paragraph lines have little overlap in length at the same public evaluation page. The paragraph-only refit tests a stronger transfer condition. Training samples may have uncertain real heads excluded. Synthetic rows retain every slot without uncertainty markers.
